newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Ag Min ups wheat crop to 2.74 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Ag Min ups wheat crop to 2.74 mln tonnes.

text.p: Brazilian wheat production should reach 2.74 million tonnes in 1997, up from a May estimate of 2.64 million tonnes, the Agriculture Ministry's National Supply Company (Conab) said in a press release.
The 1997 crop will still however be 14.5 percent down from 3.20 million tonnes in 1996, it added.

Planted area is now seen at 1.49 million hectares against 1.51 million hectares in May and 1.83 million the previous year. Higher output is expected however due to an anticipated five percent increase in productivity.
The Conab estimate compares with a forecast of 2.53 million tonnes by independent analysts Safras e Mercado in mid-June.
